# SasaVenos Predicts Weighted Pull-Up Strength Transfers To Muscle-Ups And Front Lever

SasaVenos predicts that improving weighted pull-up strength transfers to muscle-ups and front lever performance. [src: vid-BBuB0XMVhDw]

## Details

- Improving weighted pull-ups from 8 reps with 10 kg to 8 reps with 20 kg makes muscle-ups feel way easier. [src: vid-BBuB0XMVhDw]
- Improving weighted pull-ups from 3 sets of 3 with 35 kg to 3 sets of 3 with 45 kg gives a very high probability of a noticeable upgrade to front lever, even without direct front lever training. [src: vid-BBuB0XMVhDw]

## Evidence

- vid-BBuB0XMVhDw (SasaVenos): "If you get your pull-ups from 8 reps with 10 kgs to 8 reps with 20 kgs, your muscle-ups are going to feel way easier, that's for sure."
- vid-BBuB0XMVhDw (SasaVenos): "If you get your weighted pull-up from 3 sets of 3 with 35 kgs to 3 sets of 3 with 45 kgs, there is a very high probability that your front lever will get a noticeable upgrade just from that. Maybe even if you don't do any front lever at all."
